method.access_survey: All PE HIGHLOW fixups were enumerated across ENG3.DLL. Every .text fixup targeting a candidate cell was decoded as one complete instruction. Ledger row disassembly was used when a row covered the field; exact field decoding from surrounding original bytes was used otherwise. PUSH immediate address-taking references are separated from direct memory accesses. Adjacent scalar boundaries were reviewed together.
method.owner_rule: A scalar owner passes only when every direct memory operand accesses the cell base at offset 0 with no base/index register and the exact declared width. Pointer payload indexing occurs after loading a pointer and does not enlarge the pointer cell. No capacity or array inference was used.
method.anchor_rule: Each accepted cell has one complete absolute MOV with exactly one HIGHLOW operand fixup to that cell, outside all assigned callers. blocker_rows_overlapping is empty for blocker-free choices. For g_2bf30, g_2bf64, g_2bf70, g_2bff0, and g_eng3_41048, the only external MOV anchor lies in another pending row; the report records these fallbacks and the other candidate references.
